data.title: La Vie Apartments
data.about:
Welcome to La Vie at JBR: The latest launch by Dubai Properties at Jumeirah Beach Residence District. 1 – 4 bedroom apartments and penthouses with enthralling views of the Arabian Sea, Palm Jumierah, Blue Water, and Ain Dubai. 

These apartments have areas dedicated for leisure and families, in addition to state-of-the-art pool, gym and barbeque area. These homes have the best elegant interiors, with a Miami-styled architectural design. With designer fittings and a luxury resort lifestyle, homes at La Vie offers unparalleled amenities in the midst of the calm of the ocean and the bustle of the city life.

characteristics_module.title: Come home to one of the most popular places in the city, Jumeirah Beach Residence.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
With 1.7 km shoreline, JBR has various restaurants and retail outlets for you to enjoy. It is the perfect location to buy your new home, whether you are a young professional or a family. Here, you will be busy with a variety of events happening all through the year and more.

  • Dubai Marina – 5 Minutes
  • JLT – 10 Minutes
  • Burj Al Arab – 15 Minutes
  • Burj Khalifa / Downtown – 20 Minutes
  • Dubai International Airport – 25 Minutes
